Use when user says "SEO plan", "SEO strategy", "SEO planning", "content strategy", "keyword strategy", "content calendar", "site architecture", or "SEO roadmap".

copy.tagline: 制定网站SEO策略，生成行业模板与执行路线图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为网站制定SEO计划或优化搜索排名
copy.tagline_en: Create SEO strategies with industry templates and implementation roadmaps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning SEO for a website or aiming to improve search rankings

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你完成 SEO 规划：先了解你的业务类型和目标，然后分析竞争对手，设计网站结构，制定内容策略和技术方案，最后输出一份分阶段的实施路线图。
howto.when: 当你提到“SEO 计划”、“SEO 策略”、“内容策略”、“关键词策略”、“内容日历”、“网站架构”或“SEO 路线图”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个 SaaS 公司的 SEO 计划。
分析我的竞争对手的 SEO 策略。
say.note: Claude 会进行竞争分析，找出关键词差距和机会。

say.text: 给我一个 12 个月的 SEO 实施路线图。
say.note: Claude 会生成分四个阶段的行动计划。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through SEO planning: first understand your business type and goals, then analyze competitors, design site architecture, develop content strategy and technical foundation, and finally output a phased implementation roadmap.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "SEO plan", "SEO strategy", "content strategy", "keyword strategy", "content calendar", "site architecture", or "SEO roadmap".

say_en.text: Create an SEO plan for my SaaS company.
say_en.note: Claude loads the SaaS template and outputs a full strategy.
Claude performs competitive analysis and identifies gaps.

say_en.text: Give me a 12-month SEO implementation roadmap.
say_en.note: Claude generates a phased action plan.
